hints.title: Sort Coins Ascending
hints.text: Sorting coins allows inductively extending the reachable consecutive range [0, reach].

hints.title: Check Range Continuity
hints.text: If you can make all values up to reach, adding coin c extends the range to reach + c if and only if c <= reach + 1.

hints.title: Stop at First Gap
hints.text: When a coin exceeds reach + 1, no further combinations can bridge the gap, so return reach + 1.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of coins array
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting coins enables greedy contiguous range expansion in O(n log n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate explains inductive range extension: [0, reach] + c = [0, reach + c] when c <= reach + 1.
